title: France Blames Iran for a Cyberattack That Heated Supermarket Refrigerators
description: In October 2026, a cyberattack attributed to Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps targeted refrigeration systems in about 700 supermarkets across France, causing temperatures to rise to 50°C for approximately six hours. This attack led to significant financial losses, including tens of millions of euros reported by the Intermarché supermarket chain. French authorities have opened a judicial investigation and are seeking European sanctions against those responsible. The attack is described as unprecedented in scale and aggressiveness, representing a major threat to national interests and public security.
